g.text: Join RAW features first (before the head LayerNorms).

g.text: Standardize with fitted mean and standard deviation:

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Three predicted shifts: spatial, temporal, fusion.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f766e

g.text: Correct the logits, then make ONE DFD score

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: For each head: d = FAKE logit − REAL logit. Stack the three differences → D: [B, 3].

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: D_corrected = D − G → [B, 3] → sigmoid per head → mean of 3 probabilities → [B].

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Mean over the face's clips → p_dfd: ONE scalar. Live default: 8 clips per face, processed in batches.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: The live combiner receives this corrected score. The blur-probe strict score is not a combiner input.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Example: [s1, s2, s3] and [t1, t2] → [s1, s2, s3, t1, t2]. It is not addition or averaging.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Here: 1024 + 256 = 1280. Four queries are pooled, not concatenated into a 4096-vector.
